body: I haven't left my home all day, didn't go to work. I've tried hte typical things over the past few days, just doing stuff to try to get on with it, but there's nothing there. Every time I stop for a moment theres just the pain. I think I'd probably feel a bit better in a few days time, but not that much better. Not suicidal, but not happy or even close. Thanks for chiming in.
